name: Stillwater
description: A sunlike star with a living world attended by twin moons and a dwarf planet keeping the outer count. The seas run clear and the tides run double. Nothing hurries here, including the geology.

stars.name: Stillwater Light
stars.description: A calm yellow dwarf with output steady to four decimal places. Its spectrum is a textbook illustration. Worlds here get exactly the light they were promised.

planets.name: Stillsea
planets.description: A glass-calm ocean world where two moons cancel each other's tides into perfect stillness. Reefs build undisturbed in the quiet water. Divers describe the silence as a physical place.

moons.name: Hush
moons.description: A grey moon whose pull exactly stills the seas below. Tide gauges here read zero for weeks at a time. Poets make pilgrimages to watch nothing happen.

moons.name: Murmur
moons.description: A small dark moonlet whose counter-tug completes the great stilling. Its shadow cools the reefs on schedule. Biologists track spawning to its passages.

planets.name: Pebble
planets.description: A small airless rock keeping the outer watch over the still seas. Relay masts blink on its night side for passing traffic. Nobody has ever stayed longer than a shift.

dwarfPlanets.name: Stillstone
dwarfPlanets.description: A cold hybrid dwarf counting time in the outer dark. Its mixed ice and rock record the system's formation chemistry. Chronologists prize its undisturbed strata.
